_comment: GAP burn-down series for the COBOL.NET Conformance Ledger artifact, appended by scripts/spec/gen_ledger.py. ONE POINT PER BATTERY OR GAP-MOVING LANDING - a commit that moves no row adds no point, or this becomes a commit log with a y-axis. Every field is MEASURED, never remembered: each point's gap/closed/dns were read out of that commit's own tests/version-matrix/traceability-inventory.json (git show <sha>:<path>), which is why the series can be re-derived by anyone who doubts it. `battery` carries the battery number when the point is the tree a comprehensive run was measured on, and null otherwise; the chart marks that point, because a burn-down without its last gate on it invites the reader to trust an ungated number. `label` is a short chart caption for the first point only - the rest are dated. This file is DATA for a derived view; it is not a work list and must never grow one (CLAUDE.md rule 8). Seeded 2026-09-02 from the five landings that moved the inventory since the 2026-08-29 phase-B batch; earlier history is in DEVLOG.md and is recoverable the same way.
